newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips surge, NYSE curbs triggered.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips surge, NYSE curbs triggered.

text.p: U.S. blue chip shares surged in late trading, triggering a curb on index-arbitrage trading at the New York Stock Exchange, after the Federal Reserve left short-term interest rates unchanged.
The Dow Jones industrial average rose 55 to 7284, triggering the NYSE curbs at 1532 EDT/1932 GMT. It continued surging, up 80 or more than a percent to 7309 within minutes.
The Standard & Poor's 500 Index was also sharply higher, up 1.0 percent or eight points to nearly 842.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was also sharply higher, rising 18 points or 1.3 percent to 1359.
Breadth on the NYSE turned positive, with advancing stocks outnumbering decliners 14 to 11.
